answer: According to Section 1(5)(a) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, the provisions of this Act apply to any offence committed by any citizen of India in any place outside India. This means that an Indian citizen can be tried and convicted in India for acts committed abroad that would be punishable under this Act if committed within India.
summary_answer: Yes, the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 applies to Indian citizens committing offences outside India.
